cohort: 524 women who received NLA between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2021 in Bhutan
finding: The incidence of NLA usage was 3.5% (524/15,119), and while generally safe for mothers and babies, its use remains low in Bhutan, potentially due to a shortage of anesthesiologists, cultural beliefs, and lack of awareness.
mod_finding: Modes of delivery following NLA were spontaneous vaginal delivery (63.4%), cesarean section (18.4%), and assisted vaginal delivery (18.3%).
